title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 17. Recalls that programmes under heading 1 play a crucial role in supporting research and innovation in key sectors, including health, energy and climate, enhancing the Union’s autonomy, driving sustainable growth, economic development and quality job creation quality working conditions, and the reinforcement of workers skills with an emphasis on SMEs, boosting funding for cross-border infrastructure, in particular in the sustainable transport, energy and digital sectors, thus contributing significantly to the green and digital transitions;
